limitations: The synthetic consumer proves record plumbing only; the unchanged packed gate+up / down E4R32 kernels are not yet fed GPU-written offsets or coefficients (stage 3).
Exactness is established for the 4170 captured frames of the three pinned fixtures only; it is not a general equivalence proof for other inputs.
No timing is claimed: component gpuMicros are command-buffer intervals, not busy, idle or recoverable time; no ABBA or performance result is produced.
notes: Diagnostic only: no artifact, installation, promotion or default change; gainQualified, installable, productionPerformanceClaim and realE4GateComplete are always false.

Capture: one optional check in the existing SSA router_topk case, active only inside Gemma4Runner.withRouteCapture (refuses the overlap scope, instrumentation and probes; the executor refuses raw, non-prepared and overlap-prepared executions while it is active). Math, kernels, counters and defaults are unchanged and the scope clears on every exit.

Per fixture inside Q4 width 32: fresh direct reference, then a plain OFF run and a captured OFF run of the declared incumbent (v1 E4R32, modern candidate, router launch divisor 1, CPU FP64 routing), both 32 frozen IDs fed by the previous actual argmax, exact derived counters with every fallback 0, equal kernel and command-buffer totals, captured outputs within 1e-4 of the reference (vector and per-element normalized, strict) and bit-identical to the plain run at every logit.
Frames: one per layer per forward in layer order: (21+31) + (23+31) + (2+31) = 139 forwards x 30 = 4170, validated per fixture.

Replay: every frame, fixed 1024-frame chunks, two GPU passes per chunk: selector-only against the real GU/DN base/stride table proven against the resident mapping length, and the stage-1 selector + barrier + synthetic payload consumer. Every real frame must be unflagged with ids, quotient bits and coefficient bits equal to the captured incumbent and selector offsets equal to the captured actual checked offsets; the mirror is never an oracle.
Scales: an in-process copy of the loaded runner's expert scales is handed to the GPU replay only; it is never serialized, hashed or reported. Coefficient bits are compared in memory and only counted.
Reuses the phase-53 gate helpers and fixtures; the full gate (ON arm, refusal tests, performance) is not rerun. The model SHA-256 is the cached record and is never rehashed.
